title: tragacantha scrobiculata
intro: Tragacantha scrobiculata, commonly known as the 'Ghambhari' or 'Thorny caltrop', is a spiny shrub native to the dry regions of India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha scrobiculata include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
